# Variant preserves an Array shape

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Boxing and unboxing retain the complete rank-two I64 Array shape and row-major values, including an integer above 2^53. The type specimen contributes its schema, not its value.

## What this example demonstrates

## Expected result

### result

Type: `array<i64,rank=2>`; comparison: `exact`.

```json
{"shape":[2,2],"elements":[1,9007199254740993,-4,7]}
```

These are expected values, not a report of executed tests. Integers retain their exact JSON lexemes; Array shapes and nominal types remain part of the example contract.
